summary: Dr. Douglas Kerr of Johns Hopkins led a team identifying chemicals to regrow motor neurons, partially restoring paralyzed rats' walking. They call the results major progress toward curing Lou Gehrig's disease and spinal cord injuries; Dr. Karr warned human treatments are years away. Dr. Naomi Keitman said researchers "hit a brick wall until now," and the study will appear in Annals of Neurology.
